# Storyboarding shorts

**Turn an idea into a timed board, shot list, animatic and budget before generating a single video second.**

Plans 15–30 second vertical shorts before any video money is spent — a three-act hook/turn/payoff structure with second-by-second timing, beat sheets mapped to real AI video durations (Kling, Wan, Hailuo, Gemini Omni, Runway), shot lists in CSV/YAML, storyboard frames generated as cheap stills, a timed animatic with ffmpeg, continuity rules for a recurring character (wardrobe, hair, light, props, screen direction), designed transitions and loop endings, and a per-shot budget a person approves. Use when turning an idea or a series episode into shots, estimating what a short will cost, or handing a board to a batch run.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |

## How it works

1. Write the premise and the payoff first
2. Use the three-act frame
3. Turn beats into shots the models can make
4. Write the shot list
5. Draw the board with cheap stills
6. Cut an animatic and watch it with the line
7. Check continuity across shots
8. Design the transitions in the board
9. End on a loop
10. Get the board approved, then hand it off

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/storyboarding-shorts.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/storyboarding-shorts.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/storyboarding-shorts.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill storyboarding-shorts`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `storyboarding-shorts.zip` (don't unzip it).
